retained_but_unendorsed_secondary_prose_.action: retain original source text as unendorsed discrepancy
retained_but_unendorsed_secondary_prose_.issue: The source change list misdescribes IIB as myometrial invasion at any histologic aggressiveness. Primary FIGO2023 IIB is nonaggressive histology with substantial LVSI; IIC is aggressive histology with myometrial invasion. Do not use the secondary change-list wording as criteria or infer LVSI/histology from MRI.

retained_but_unendorsed_secondary_prose_.action: retain original source text as unendorsed discrepancy
retained_but_unendorsed_secondary_prose_.issue: The source prose says no LVSI for IA3. The primary FIGO2023 IA3 criterion excludes substantial/extensive LVSI, not every focal LVSI. A figure case described as no LVSI is publication-supplied case information and is not a universal criterion or an MRI inference.
